name: credit-gate
description: Stops every Claude Code agent from spending usage credits until you say so. When your claude.ai plan crosses a usage threshold (5-hour or weekly), all sessions, subagents and workflow agents pause on one macOS dialog: Allow credits until the window resets, or Stop. macOS only; needs jq.

five_hour_threshold.title: 5-hour threshold (%)
five_hour_threshold.description: Pause all agents and ask once 5-hour plan usage reaches this percentage

seven_day_threshold.title: Weekly threshold (%)
seven_day_threshold.description: Pause all agents and ask once weekly plan usage reaches this percentage
